content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The retroactive authorization window is closed, and Meridian does not offer peer-to-peer review, so neither route is available under its published rules. A CO-197 denial is on the table, making a formal appeal with supporting medical-necessity documentation the only available compliant action that can still pursue payer reimbursement; similar appeals have also produced payment in 8 of 18 cases."}
